title: Cozy Putt - Week 1 Update
author: ImportGuy
selftext:
Cozy Putt Week 1 Update: 

Decided to create a distinct course you and put you and I'm really glad that I did, it feels way better to play. 

I also worked on more varied 3D models and better ambient lighting, along with a dev console to modify it in real time so I can export those settings to be global rather than trying and go back-and-forth with an AI to do it. 

Next is building out more holes in the main courses, but would love feedback and suggestions, also, still looking for a better name than Cozy Putt.
